roads.name: Northwest 141st Court
words: Curve after curve after curve: 62 in 3.4 miles, about 18 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 104 to 172 ft, with 296 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.36 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: West Riverbend Road
words: Properly twisty: 14 curves in 2.6 miles, about 5 a mile.
From 29 to 66 ft, with 143 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 44 buildings a mile beside the road.

roads.name: Immokalee Road
words: Properly twisty: 12 curves in 2.1 miles, about 6 a mile.
The 1.5 miles at the east end are tamer, with about 3 side roads a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 114 to 167 ft, with 194 ft of up and down along the way.
